description: This file defines route handlers for project-related API endpoints in an Express.js application. It includes CRUD operations, project overview, and user usage details, integrating with models and services for projects, tenants, and analytics.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list projects using a CRUD controller.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a project by ID.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a project by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a project.

methods.name: router.get('/:projectId/overview')
methods.description: Provides an overview of a specific project, including usage, access, and credits information.

methods.name: router.get('/:projectId/users/usage')
methods.description: Returns usage metrics per user for a specific project, including costs and time spent.
